ValidationRule.description: User should populate the values in the Question field mapping section when the Data type is Dependent picklist.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Data_Type__c, 'Dependent Picklist'), OR( LEN(Dependent_Field_Question__c) = 0, ISBLANK(Dependent_Question_Setup__c) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Both the dependent question and dependent question setup field should be required.
